method.description: Alpha-weighted KMeans over visible pixels, with transparent/near-transparent pixels excluded; deterministic NumPy generator seed 42; 120,000 sampled pixels; 8 clusters; n_init=5; representative hex is the nearest actual source pixel to each computed cluster centre.
method.share_basis: Alpha-weighted share among the analysed visible logo pixels; values rounded to 0.1 percentage point.
